name: GlobalGapComplianceWorkbook
tagline: Good agricultural practice self-assessment, corrective actions and audit readiness in one Power Platform app
description: A complete GAP certification preparation module for growers, packhouses and producer groups: assess control points module by module, keep an evidence register, raise non-conformances, run corrective actions through verification, plan internal inspections and see the readiness score before the audit. Canvas, model-driven and Power Pages.
features: Readiness score and audit-ready verdict (Majors 100 %, Minors vs threshold)
Checklist by module with progress and quick assess
Major actions due before the audit
Bulk actions, CSV export, undo and audit trail
controlType: standard (2 controls: data-set + Power Pages field control)
